title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Teardown Rule: Long Teardowns
content:
**Rule.** A long Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown adds a long-teardown add-on to the teardown charge. The teardown span is the calendar days from the check-in date to the estimate written date. An estimate of more than **100** labor hours with a teardown span of at least **4** days adds **85.00 USD**; exactly one of those two conditions adds **40.00 USD**; neither adds none.

The labor hours are the estimate's total labor hours on the booking.

**Truth table**

| More than 100 labor hours | Teardown span of at least 4 days | Long-teardown add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 85.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 40.00 USD |
| No | Yes | 40.00 USD |
| No | No | none |

**Boundary cases** (hypothetical estimates)

- 100.0 labor hours is not more than 100; 100.1 is.
- Checked in 2 April and written 6 April: a span of 4 days, at least 4. Written 5 April: 3 days, under 4.
- 120.0 hours, checked in 2 April, written 6 April: both conditions — 85.00 USD.
- 100.0 hours, checked in 2 April, written 6 April: exactly one condition — 40.00 USD.
- 80.0 hours, checked in 2 April, written 4 April: neither — none.
